name: Nate Lawson
source:
Likes: Getting things done, cleanliness, the school
Dislikes: Being told what to do, smartphones, mistakes

Nate is a workaholic perfectionist who's wound several notches too tightly. He tried to keep things together but is highly emotional and will get upset with any small push. Nate is respected within the school, though others wisely admire him from afar as much as possible.
